name: Screen sharing
description: Another computer's screen in a tab, over VNC: this Mac's, your other machines', or any VNC server you reach. Show the whole screen, or just one app's window. Only you, on your own devices.
author: Vaultite

localPort.label: This Mac's VNC port
localPort.description: where this Mac's Screen Sharing answers

allowUsers.label: Other tailnet logins
allowUsers.description: tailnet logins besides this Mac's owner that may open a screen through Tailscale Serve, like someone@example.com

allowRemote.label: Anyone who reaches the app
allowRemote.description: lets anyone who reaches the app open a screen, not only this Mac's owner and the logins above: only on a network you trust

screens.description: every screen that can be opened in a tab, each Mac's own and the VNC servers in the settings, and whether each answers
screens.live: the screens' VNC servers, asked live
